items.title: Nvidia customers face over 15% server price hikes as memory costs soar - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- Rising memory chip costs are pushing up the price of servers that use Nvidia Corp’s artificial intelligence chips, with some of the chipmaker’s biggest customers facing increases of more than 15%, Bloomberg News reported on Saturday, citing people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Nvidia customers notified about AI-related price hikes above 15%, Bloomberg News reports
items.summary: Some of Nvidia's largest customers have been told prices of servers ‌containing its AI chips will rise by ‌more than 15% in many cases with memory chip ​costs soaring, Bloomberg News reported on Saturday.  The price hikes will go into effect on systems shipped early next year and will impact systems including ‌those with the ⁠flagship Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell chips, the report added, citing people familiar ⁠with the process.  The increases will depend on Nvidia's chip generation and memory configurations, they ​said.

items.title: Oracle (ORCL) Starts PR Push For Project Jupiter AI Data Center
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) has launched a major public relations campaign to defend its massive Project Jupiter AI data center amid growing local opposition. Community groups and policymakers in several large US states are pushing moratoriums and stricter permitting rules on new data centers that support AI workloads.
